summary: A Producer Company may pass a general meeting resolution to transfer its assets and liabilities, divide itself, amalgamate, or merge with another Producer Company. Members and creditors must receive written notice and a copy of the proposed resolution. Non-consenting members or creditors have specific options to transfer shares or withdraw deposits within one month.
points: A Producer Company may decide to transfer its assets and liabilities, divide into new companies, amalgamate, or merge by passing a resolution at a general meeting.
Resolutions require a majority of total members with at least two-thirds of members present and voting.
Written notice and a copy of the proposed resolution must be given to all members and creditors before passing the resolution.
Non-consenting members may transfer their shares to an active member with Board approval, and non-consenting creditors may withdraw their deposit, loan, or advance within one month.
Members or creditors who do not exercise their option within the specified period are deemed to have consented to the resolution.
Any member, creditor, or employee aggrieved by the transfer, division, amalgamation, or merger may appeal to the Tribunal within thirty days.
example: Meera Textiles Producer Company Limited decided to merge with Kisan Agro Producer Company Limited by passing a resolution at its general meeting. Before the meeting, Meera Textiles gave written notice and a copy of the proposed resolution to all its members and creditors. Rohit, a member who did not consent to the merger, chose to transfer his shares with the Board's approval to an active member within one month. Meanwhile, Anita, a non-consenting creditor, chose to withdraw her deposit within the same one-month period. Since other members and creditors did not exercise their options, they were deemed to have consented, allowing the merger process to move forward under the law.

terms.meaning: To combine two or more companies to form a new company.
When one company is combined into another existing company.
A specialized legal body set up to deal with specific types of disputes and appeals.

watch: Non-consenting members and creditors must act within one month, or they will be legally deemed to have agreed to the resolution.
